# Andrew Handyman Services

> Handyman services in Wesley Chapel, Florida and the northern Tampa Bay area (Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills, Dade City, New Tampa, Lutz, Odessa, Tampa). Run by Andrew, a local handyman. Free estimates. Phone and text: (656) 231-1836. Website: https://andrewhandy.com/

Notes: Andrew does not do work that legally requires a licensed electrician or plumber. Prices are listed only where stated below; otherwise estimates are free.

## Services
- [Christmas Light Installation](https://andrewhandy.com/services/christmas-light-installation/): Professional C9 holiday lighting in any color, cut to fit your home, installed, taken down in January and stored until next season. No tangled wires, no leftover cut ends and no ladder falls for you. Call for a free estimate.
- [TV, Shelf & Curtain Rod Mounting](https://andrewhandy.com/services/tv-shelf-mounting/): TV mounting for every size, from 43 to 98 inches, on drywall, brick, stone and lanai walls, with neat, hidden wires. I also hang shelves and curtain rods in Wesley Chapel and nearby. Call for a free estimate.
- [Drywall Repair](https://andrewhandy.com/services/drywall-repair/): Holes, cracks, dents and water damage patched and finished so smoothly you will never know they were there. Serving homeowners in Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills and nearby.
- [Wood Rot & Damage Repair](https://andrewhandy.com/services/wood-rot-repair/): Florida humidity and summer rain are hard on wood. I repair or replace rotted and damaged wooden elements inside and outside your home before the damage spreads.
- [Interior & Exterior Painting](https://andrewhandy.com/services/painting/): Walls, ceilings, trim and exteriors painted with careful prep, crisp lines and a clean finish. I paint homes and rooms for customers in Wesley Chapel and nearby neighborhoods.
- [Cabinet Painting & Renovation](https://andrewhandy.com/services/cabinet-painting-renovation/): Give your kitchen or whole house a fresh look without paying for full replacement. I paint and renovate cabinets for homeowners in Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills and nearby.
- [New Kitchen Installation](https://andrewhandy.com/services/new-kitchen-installation/): Full kitchen remodels handled start to finish: old cabinets out, new cabinets in, countertops, backsplash and finishing touches. Serving Wesley Chapel and the surrounding area.
- [Hurricane Shutters](https://andrewhandy.com/services/hurricane-shutters/): Be ready before the next storm. I install roll-down, accordion and motorized hurricane shutters to protect your windows and doors, for homes in Wesley Chapel and across Pasco and north Hillsborough.
- [Media & Accent Walls](https://andrewhandy.com/services/media-accent-walls/): Refresh your living room with a custom accent wall, or turn your TV area into a media wall with shelves, cabinets and a fireplace. Designed around your space and installed start to finish in Wesley Chapel and across Tampa Bay. Accent walls start from $1,500.
- [Deck Repair](https://andrewhandy.com/services/deck-repair/): Loose, rotted or worn deck boards, railings and steps repaired so your deck is safe and good-looking again. Serving Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills and nearby.
- [Picture, Mirror & Art Hanging](https://andrewhandy.com/services/picture-hanging/): Pictures, mirrors, canvases and gallery walls hung level, centered and secure, on drywall, brick, block and tile. Moving in or redecorating in Wesley Chapel? Send me a photo of the wall for a free estimate.
- [Furniture Assembly](https://andrewhandy.com/services/furniture-assembly/): Beds, dressers, desks, bookcases, patio sets and more, built and placed where you want them. IKEA, Wayfair, Amazon, Costco or any flat-pack brand, in Wesley Chapel and nearby. Text me what you bought for a free estimate.
- [Door Installation & Repair](https://andrewhandy.com/services/door-installation/): French doors, patio doors, entry and interior doors installed, trimmed and adjusted so they open smoothly and close tight. Door repair and lock replacement too, in Wesley Chapel and nearby. Call for a free estimate.
- [Flooring Installation](https://andrewhandy.com/services/flooring-installation/): Luxury vinyl plank, laminate and click-lock flooring installed room by room, with baseboards and transitions fitted neatly. Serving Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills and nearby. Call for a free estimate.
- [Leather & Vinyl Repair](https://andrewhandy.com/services/leather-vinyl-repair/): Cracks, tears and worn spots on leather and vinyl recliners, sofas, chairs and trim, repaired so they blend back in. Serving Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Zephyrhills and nearby. Call for a free estimate.
- [Fence Repair](https://andrewhandy.com/services/fence-repair/): Broken pickets, leaning posts and damaged gates fixed or replaced to keep your yard secure and your fence looking sharp. Serving Wesley Chapel and nearby communities.

## Pricing published on the site
- Media & accent walls: accent wall with TV mounting and mantel from $1,500; full media wall typically $3,500 to $4,000; large custom projects $6,000 to $10,000+. See https://andrewhandy.com/services/media-accent-walls/
- Handyman subscription: Basic $99/month (up to 2 hours), Plus $199/month (up to 4 hours), Home $299/month (up to 6 hours). Unused hours roll over for up to 3 months. See https://andrewhandy.com/subscription/
- Gift certificates: $147, $287 or $478 toward handyman work. See https://andrewhandy.com/gift/
